takeaways: Gorakhpur me lab ki kami nahi hai — isliye "kahan" ka sawaal chhota hai aur "kaunsi" ka bada. Bahar se dekh kar ye tay nahi hota.
Do cheezein sach me poochhi ja sakti hain: report par test ka method chhapta hai ya nahi, aur reference range report par khud chhapi hai ya nahi.

Visit late hone ki sabse badi wajah adhoora pata hoti hai, slot nahi. Naye mohallon me plot number se zyada kaam landmark karta hai.
Hum 24 ghante khuli lab hone ka daawa nahi karte — 24 ghante me report dene ka karte hain.

sections.heading: Pathology Lab In Gorakhpur — Sawaal "Kahan" Nahi, "Kaunsi" Hai
sections.lead: Is sheher me lab dhoondhna mushkil nahi hai. Chunna mushkil hai.
blocks: Gorakhpur poore ilaake ka referral hub hai — AIIMS Gorakhpur, BRD Medical College aur zila aspatal yahin hain, aur unke aas-paas diagnostic centre ki kami bilkul nahi hai. Isliye yahan wo sawaal hi nahi banta jo Deoria ya Salempur me banta hai. Yahan sawaal doosra hai: itne vikalpon me se chunein kaise.

Aur ye bahar se dekh kar tay nahi hota. Chamakti reception, bada board aur lambi line — inka machine ki calibration se koi rishta nahi hai. Bheed ka matlab sirf itna hai ki wo jagah jaani-pehchani hai, ye nahi ki uski report behtar hai.

Is guide me do cheezein hain. Pehli — sheher ke kis mohalle me ghar se sample liya jaata hai, aur wahan pata kaise likhna chahiye. Doosri — kisi bhi lab se poochhne layak wo do sawaal jo sach me kuch batate hain.

note.title: Jo yahan se nahi hota
note.text: X-ray, ultrasound, ECG, CT scan aur MRI machine par hoti hain, sample par nahi — inka koi home option hota hi nahi aur ye hamari service me shaamil bhi nahi hain. Parche par inme se kuch likha ho to imaging centre jaana hi padega. Blood aur urine wala hissa ghar se karwa lijiye, taaki us trip par sirf wahi kaam bache. AIIMS aur BRD ka naam yahan sirf bhugol ke taur par hai — unse hamara koi sambandh ya saajhedari nahi hai.

sections.heading: Ghar Se Sample Lene Wali Pathology Gorakhpur — Do Cheezein Jo Sach Me Poochhi Ja Sakti Hain
sections.lead: Baaki sab bataya jaata hai. Ye do cheezein report par khud chhapti hain.
blocks: Lab chunte waqt log aksar daam poochte hain aur wahin ruk jaate hain. Daam sabse kam kaam ki cheez hai, kyunki wo sabse aasani se badla ja sakta hai. Do cheezein aisi hain jo report par khud chhapti hain — unhe koi bata nahi sakta, wo dikhti hain.

list: Report par test ka method chhapta hai ya nahi — CLIA, ECLIA, ELISA. Hormone aur vitamin me ye farak asli hota hai, aur jo lab apna method likhti hai wo apne number ke peeche khadi hai.
Reference range report par khud chhapi hai ya nahi. Range machine, umar aur ling ke hisaab se badalti hai. Jo report aapko internet par range dhoondhne par majboor kar de, wo adhoori report hai.

blocks: Teesri baat poochhne ki nahi, karne ki hai: jo number aap mahino tak track kar rahe hain — HbA1c, TSH, creatinine, haemoglobin — unke liye lab badalte mat rahiye. Do alag analyser par TSH 4.5 aur 4.1 aane ka matlab thyroid ka badalna nahi hai, sirf machine ka badalna hai. Doctor ko badlav dekhna hota hai, aur badlav tabhi dikhta hai jab baaki sab kuch same rahe. Gorakhpur me ye galti isliye zyada hoti hai kyunki vikalp bahut hain aur har baar jahan sahulat ho wahin karwa liya jaata hai.

Building ya makaan ka naam aur floor likhiye, saath me sabse paas ki dukaan ya chauraha. Purane sheher me dukaan hi sabse bharosemand landmark hai, aur isi se visit samay par hoti hai.

faqs.question: Mera mohalla list me naam se nahi hai — service milegi ya nahi?
faqs.answer: Pehle call kar lijiye. faqs.question: Hospital me bhartee mareez ka sample ghar wali service se liya ja sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Bhartee mareez ki jaanch us hospital ki apni vyavastha ka hissa hoti hai, aur uske beech me aana theek bhi nahi hai. Haan, hospital ke paas ruke hue tiimardar apna ya ghar ke kisi aur ka test karwa sakte hain — us haalat me wahi pata dijiye jahan aap us subah maujood hain, sthayi ghar ka nahi.

faqs.question: Gorakhpur me lab chunte waqt sabse kaam ki cheez kya dekhein?
faqs.answer: Do cheezein jo report par khud chhapti hain: test ka method (CLIA, ECLIA, ELISA) aur reference range. Method likhne wali lab apne number ke peeche khadi hai, aur bina range wali report padhi hi nahi ja sakti. Teesri baat karne ki hai — jo number aap mahino tak track karte hain, unke liye lab badalte mat rahiye.

faqs.question: Gorakhpur me 24 ghante khuli lab hai?
faqs.answer: Hamari nahi. Hum 24 ghante khuli lab hone ka daawa nahi karte — hum 24 ghante me report dene ka karte hain. Home visit ke slot subah 6 baje se shuru hote hain aur shaam tak chalte hain, isliye fasting wale test subah aur baaki test din me kabhi bhi ho jaate hain. Raat me turant jaanch ki zaroorat ho to wo emergency hai, aur uske liye hospital jaana chahiye.

faqs.question: Ghar se liya gaya sample lab tak pahunchne me kharab to nahi hota?
faqs.answer: Sample lene ke baad wo usi din processing ke liye bhej diya jaata hai — routine blood aur urine test isi tareeke se hote hain, ye koi nayi vyavastha nahi hai. Kisi bhi collection centre se bhi sample isi tarah aage jaata hai. Aap apni taraf se do cheezein kar sakte hain: tay slot par taiyaar rahiye, aur fasting wale test me saada paani peete rahiye.
